name: Goodbye
when: Closing a chat or signing out

variants.name: Wave bye
variants.desc: A slow, content wave with closed eyes.

variants.name: Shrink away
variants.desc: Shrinks down to a dot, then pops back.

variants.name: Hop off
variants.desc: Hops off to the right and out of sight.

variants.name: Poof
variants.desc: Vanishes in a puff of smoke.

parts.t: <g class="cheeks"><ellipse cx="{{a.ck1}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse><ellipse cx="{{a.ck2}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse></g>

<g class="eg eg-u" stroke="{{a.eye}}"><g transform="translate({{a.lex}} {{a.ley}})"><path class="gl" d="M-5 -1.5Q0 4 5 -1.5"></path></g><g transform="translate({{a.rex}} {{a.rey}})"><path class="gl" d="M-5 -1.5Q0 4 5 -1.5"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-hand" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.mo}})"><g transform="translate(85 47)"><g class="a hnd"><path class="hc" d="M-4 0C-6 -4 -5.5 -11 0 -11.5C5.5 -11 6 -4 4 0Z"></path></g><path class="a mot grey" d="M-9 -15Q-12 -10 -10 -5M9 -15Q12 -10 10 -5"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-poof" transform="translate(0 {{a.mo}})"><circle class="a pf smoke" cx="36" cy="52" r="10"></circle><circle class="a pf smoke" cx="60" cy="44" r="12"></circle><circle class="a pf smoke" cx="52" cy="62" r="11"></circle><circle class="a pf smoke" cx="40" cy="36" r="8"></circle><circle class="a pf smoke" cx="67" cy="60" r="8"></circle></g>
